subject.title: fix: resolve Tavily SecretRefs in agent tools

question: Should the adopted broader branch become the canonical fix for both the Tavily fallback and agent Tool Search runtime-snapshot failures?
rationale: Two proof-positive branches overlap on the Tavily fix, while only this PR includes the agent runtime-snapshot repair; selecting one canonical landing path prevents duplicate credential logic and test drift.

options.title: Refresh and land this PR
options.body: Rebase the adopted branch onto current main, require green affected exact-head gates, merge it as the canonical fix, and retire overlapping Tavily-only candidates.

options.title: Split the agent repair
options.body: Land the narrower Tavily-only fix and request the runtime-snapshot helper and Tool Search coverage as a separate focused PR.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Keep both PRs open while maintainers reassess the credential fallback and runtime-snapshot ownership boundary.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land this PR
recommendation.body: Rebase the adopted branch onto current main, require green affected exact-head gates, merge it as the canonical fix, and retire overlapping Tavily-only candidates.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline shows direct adoption, assignment, and authorship of the consolidated branch commit.
